title: Fred Reed's letter on relandscaping the mesa

tellings.quote: They came basically to rellandscape the the uh mesa.

plain: After an alleged 1948 crash of a craft on a mesa in Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, a team is said to have come back "basically to relandscape the mesa," hiding any trace of what happened. Scott Ramsey, who has researched the crash story, says this comes from a letter by a man named Fred Reed dated March 27, 1999. It would mean someone worked to erase the site on purpose.
